title: four pre-commit arms report an exit code nothing reads, and one says its findings never gate from inside the branch that gates on them
body:
**RESTORED ARCHAEOLOGY, TRANSCRIBED VERBATIM ON 2026-08-31.** This issue was filed with an empty body because no verb could write one -- the defect `0090` names -- so its finding survived only in the commit that filed it. The prose below is its author's, carried whole from `769b6e14` (*issue(0093): a claim about a measurement nobody took*). **Nothing in it is written by the restorer**; the header you are reading is the only addition, and the commit's hard line wraps are joined without a word changed.

cc found this correcting their own earlier diagnosis of the same incident. Driven independently at 488696e3 before filing: 12 pre-commit arms use if ! bash, ZERO capture $?, and 4 carry a canned "(exit 2; ...)" parenthetical.

Both halves of the rulings_check line were false during a live incident tonight. A dangling ratification row blocked every commit in this shared tree for about forty minutes. The guard exited 1 -- measured, and found a defect -- while the gate printed "exit 2" and "its findings never gate", from inside the branch that was gating on that finding.

The cost is measured rather than hypothetical. I read the message, drove the guard standalone, got rc=1, and reported a discrepancy between its two callers -- investigating the instrument while the instrument was working perfectly and cc's row was wrong. cc then reasoned from die()-is-2 to a second wrong cause and sent that before driving the caller and retracting. Two nodes, two wrong causes, one correct instrument.

This is the estate's class in its purest form yet. Every other instance this month was an instrument answering about the wrong subject. This is a message asserting an integer never read from anything -- and being a literal, it cannot become wrong, it can only always have been an assertion.

It was probably true when written: line 306 records corrected_check.sh exiting 2 across all twenty corrected rows. cc's own rule arriving in someone else's file -- a remedy that was never true is caught by review, one that EXPIRES is caught by nobody. Fourth sibling of 0087, 0089 and 0088's citation half.

Three remedies recorded. The first makes "refused to measure" and "measured and failed" distinguishable to the operator, which is AC-00.5's question arriving one layer up, inside our own gate.
